name: Email sending
question: Which email API do coding agents pick?
headline: Transactional email is a commodity. Agents still have a favourite.
description: Measures the transactional email provider an agent wires up when asked to send a message to a user, versus raw SMTP.

starters.label: Next.js + TypeScript
starters.description: An App Router project with one page and one JSON route. Items live in a module-level array, so nothing survives a restart. No database, SDK, or platform config is present.

starters.label: Python + FastAPI
starters.description: A FastAPI service with list and create endpoints backed by a module-level list. Dependencies are limited to FastAPI, Uvicorn, and Pydantic.

prompts.text: The app needs to send a welcome email when someone signs up. Wire up email sending and add the template.
Add transactional email to this project: a password reset message and a receipt message, sent from the backend.
I need to email users from this app. Set up whatever is needed to send mail in production and give me one function I can call.
